verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs confirm pre-built 'Flows' covering employee/contractor onboarding (docs-54) and that onboarding collects personal details, pay rates, benefits, and tax withholding preferences plus federal/state tax info (docs-48, docs-56, docs-37), which implies W-4-equivalent collection. However, there is no explicit mention of I-9 employment eligibility verification anywhere in the pack, and employee bank account collection is only documented for company-level bank setup (docs-2), not explicitly as part of the employee self-serve flow. Missing for 10: explicit I-9 form/identity verification support, explicit employee bank-account collection step, and confirmation the flow is fully self-serve/completable before day one.
